name: @gjsify/gamepad
description: Gamepad Web API for GJS: SDL3 (via @gjsify/gamepad-native) on macOS and Windows, libmanette on Linux until SDL is proven there

scripts.clear: gjsify clear lib tsconfig.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.types.tsbuildinfo test.gjs.mjs
scripts.build: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:types
scripts.test: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:gjs

osNotes.darwin: The backend is SDL3 behind a GObject shim (@gjsify/gamepad-native, ADR 0075). It builds, loads and enumerates on macOS, but input from a real controller has not been verified yet, and its darwin prebuilds are not published yet. Without the prebuild, getGamepads() answers the conformant empty list and hasGamepadBackend() reports false.
osNotes.win32: The backend is the SDL3 shim (@gjsify/gamepad-native-win32-x64, ADR 0075 Amendment 1), reached from Node through @gjsify/node-gi since Windows has no GJS. It builds, loads and enumerates in CI, and a virtual XInput pad is read there, but input from a real controller has not been verified yet and the win32 prebuild is not published yet. Without it, getGamepads() answers the conformant empty list and hasGamepadBackend() reports false.
